correctness.rationale: A triple a,b,c is frameproof iff each victim fails the descendant mask ((a XOR c)&(b XOR c))!=0 and the two cyclic analogues. Bitwise translation normalizes a code to contain zero. A recursive increasing-word exhaustive search covers all other 63 binary six-tuples and enforces exactly these necessary/sufficient tests. Independent recompiled C++ finished with 30 zero-containing eight-word maxima, no nine-word code and all maxima XOR-closed. Separately implemented Python independently confirmed exactly 240 affine cosets, weight enumerator 1+4z³+3z⁴ for each subspace, and one permutation/translation orbit. Thus size8, all punctured simplex [6,3] cosets, and complete count, with no extrapolation beyond six bits.
